pageTitle: What are your grounds for possession?
heading: What are your grounds for possession?
paragraphs: Select the grounds you want to use for this claim. These may be the same grounds you included in the notice you served.
If you want to rely on additional grounds for possession since serving the notice, you can select them here.
Read guidance about possession grounds (opens in new tab).

mandatory.hint: If you make a claim on mandatory grounds, the court will accept your reasons for possession if they can be proven. Select all that apply.

discretionary.hint: If you make a claim on discretionary grounds, a judge can decide whether to grant possession. You will need to demonstrate that possession is reasonable. Select all that apply.
